info.name: WhoisAlfaz Website & SEO Audit API
info.description:
## WhoisAlfaz Website & Technical SEO Audit API

Official public REST API collection for the **[WhoisAlfaz Website Audit Engine](https://whoisalfaz.me/audit/)**.

Run instant, automated, multi-vector diagnostic audits on any web domain covering:
- **Core Web Vitals & Real Performance (FCP, CLS, TBT)**
- **SSL Certificate Validity & Cipher Strength**
- **Security Headers (HSTS, CSP, X-Frame-Options)**
- **DNS Records & Infrastructure Latency**
- **Meta Tags & Social Open Graph Cards**
- **Robots.txt & XML Sitemap Indexability**

### 🔗 Key Links
- **Web Auditor:** [https://whoisalfaz.me/audit/](https://whoisalfaz.me/audit/)
- **Technical Documentation & Benchmarks:** [https://whoisalfaz.me/blog/screaming-frog-alternatives-free-seo-audit-tools/](https://whoisalfaz.me/blog/screaming-frog-alternatives-free-seo-audit-tools/)
- **Author & Automation Architecture:** [https://whoisalfaz.me/](https://whoisalfaz.me/)
- **npm Package:** `npx whoisalfaz-audit <url>`
- **Python Package:** `pip install whoisalfaz-audit`

request.description:
Submits a URL to be audited across 6 parallel technical vectors. Returns an overall score (0-100), letter grade (A-F), diagnostic checks, and a shareable web report URL.

### Payload Parameters:
- `url` *(string, required)*: The target URL to audit (e.g., `https://example.com`)
- `name` *(string, optional)*: User or business name.
- `email` *(string, optional)*: If provided, a formatted PDF/HTML scorecard is emailed via Brevo.
